name: GetOdds data gateway
description: The Odds API v4-compatible routes at every GetOdds book (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetRivers, Pinnacle, Novig) with per-event player props and scores; DraftKings and FanDuel DFS slates and salaries; Player props at every book (FanDuel, DraftKings, BetRivers, Pinnacle, Novig, PrizePicks, Underdog, DK Pick6) with line history, Novig exchange prices, scoped player thresholds from four sources, DraftKings-via-ESPN prices, native FanDuel and BetRivers US-PA prices, and explicitly bounded analysis and evidence APIs. Price analysis is conditional; computed assessments are not official sportsbook settlements.
